items.t: Front coil springs rust and snap (recall)
items.job: Replace both front coil springs and align wheels
items.note: Free under recall in salt-belt states; check the VIN. A broken spring that cut a tire adds tire cost.

items.job: Replace CVT with a remanufactured unit
items.note: A used CVT costs less, and on an older car may be the better choice. A fluid change may help a mild case.

items.t: Passenger airbag may be switched off by a damaged sensor connector (recall)
items.job: Replace seat belt tension sensor connector
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.job: Replace CVT with a remanufactured unit
items.note: A software update or fluid change fixes some mild cases. Ask a dealer about any extended CVT coverage.

items.t: Car can be shifted out of Park without pressing the brake (recall)
items.job: Replace shift knob or shifter assembly
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Side airbags can go off when a door is slammed (recall)
items.job: Install jumper harness and replace side impact sensors
items.note: Free under recall; check the VIN. If airbags already deployed, repair costs much more.

items.t: Console trim can catch the driver's shoe (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Passenger front airbag may not hold its shape (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Key can slip out of Run and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Many cars pass inspection and need no parts. Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Backup camera image can be blanked out by display settings (recall)
items.note: Software fix done free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Front turn signal bulb can crack and go out (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Power steering assist can cut out (recall)
items.job: Replace steering column with power assist unit
items.note: Many cars need only an inspection. Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Engine start/stop button can stick and shut off the engine (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 15V-418. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel tank may develop a leak at the seam (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-112. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driver airbag may not inflate correctly (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 24V-154. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Dealer-installed portable navigation battery can overheat (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 10V-401. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Side curtain airbag seam can tear when it deploys (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 16V-724. Check the VIN first.
